data.name: Dariyavi
data.gender_notes: Dariyavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dari represents wealth and prosperity, Yavi is the Goddess of prosperity and abundance. The name Dariyavi carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dariyavi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wealth and abundance in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Dariyavi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dariyavi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dariyavi is rooted in the ancient Indian tradition that associates names with certain qualities and divine influences. The name Dariyavi is composed of two Sanskrit words, Dari and Yavi. Dari means "wealth" or "prosperity," suggesting the abundance and riches that the bearer of this name is believed to possess or attract. In Indian culture, where names have deep significance, this name would be associated with successful business ventures, financial security, and overall material prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: Yavi is the Goddess of abundance and prosperity in Hindu mythology. In the Hindu belief system, Goddess Yavi is often revered for her ability to bestow wealth and blessings upon her devotees. The inclusion of Yavi in the name Dariyavi imbues the name with spiritual significance, implying that the one carrying the name is not just materially wealthy, but is also spiritually blessed by the Goddess Yavi. This name emphasizes the idea that material wealth is a manifestation of divine blessings and is not only a source of worldly comforts but also a means to serve and uplift those around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dariyavi represents the radiant goddess of wisdom and knowledge. Her name signifies the illumination of the mind and the pursuit of truth. As the embodiment of learning and insight, she inspires intellectual growth and understanding.

historical_references.reference: The name Dariyavi is mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic poem. It is mentioned as the name of a city in the kingdom of Haihayas, ruled by Bhagadatta.
historical_references.context: Mahabharata is a Sanskrit epic that is one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India, the other being the Ramayana. It is traditionally attributed to Vyasa and is a part of the Hindu itihasa literature.

historical_references.reference: The name Dariyavi is also mentioned in the Puranas, Hindu scriptures that discuss ancient Hindu history and traditions. It is described as a city of great importance in the region of Malwa, ruled by the Yadava king Anarta.
historical_references.context: Puranas are a collection of eighteen major texts and numerous upapuranas, and are one of the key primary sources for understanding Hinduism.
